Printed at SangmafBooks and Prints Hawakhana, Tura-794001 --- Page 5 --- AGANCHENGANI Ia golpo mingkolgrik anga an'tangni seanirang ongja, pe'skagiminrangsa.
Golporangko dingtang dingtang ki-taprangoniko ra'aha.
Iarangoniko bang-batakon Nokdangni Ripeng aro Do.kua magazinerango gatmanaha.

Golpo minggittamde, chong'motan, “Alda Noko Golmal," "Good Night Ma Goodbye" aro "1946-ni Christmas," ong'chongmotgipa "Ja-ade A -stenisa" ia minggnikode kan'dikgipa golporangni ning'o napatna man:ja.
"Arthurni Siani"-ko “"King Arthur And The Knights of the Round Table"-oniko raa, jekon “Morte D' Arthur" ineba minga.
Golpoko segipa Sir Thomas Malory (1430-1471) uni ja-manchi janggi tanganio an'chi-pari nikate golmal gondogol ong'ate janggi tangahani gimin, uko baditaba bilsirangna pattoko donataha.
Pattoko dongmitingo Malory ia golpoko seaha.
Uni siani bilsi 14- ka-chenggipa William Caxton ia ki-tapko chappa ka'ataha.
“Jaade A-stenisa"-ra Americani Presidentrangni janggi tanganiming nangchapgipa obostarang ong-a.

Americani (USA) Presidentrang dal-dalgipa ningsinggipa manderang ong'a, indiba ramram manderangni kusi ong'e, duk ong'e aro basakoba ka-ding wacheke Ramram manderangni gunrang uamangoba donga, maina gisik ka'tongode uamangba ramram manderangsan-ja'ade a'stenisan.
"Ja-ade A-stenisa"-o 1789-1981 bilsirangni gisepo President ong'giparangni sakprakni janggi tanganioniko mingprak obostakosan onaia.
lano on gipa golporangoniko mitamrangko Indiani manderang sea, mitamrangkora Englishko Ku-amagita a'songrangni ambi atchurangni chasongni golporang ong'a.
"Mikbokrakgipani Bon-kamgipa Ku'pattiani," "Sawasa Matram Bi-sako So-otachim" aro “Suraj Narayan" _iarang Indiani --- Page 6 --- manderangni skidapaniko on'na segipa kandikgipa golporang ong'a.
"Kakketgipa Manderang" (Russiani golpo), “"Rajani Mikkang" (Italyni golpo) aro “Singho-Tarigiparang"-ia golporangko N.K.
Aggarwalani chimongdimgipa “The King's Face Jain aro Sunita Jainni chimongdimgipa “One Friday Morning and Other Stories"-oniko ra'a.
Hema Pandeni 1984 bilsio pe-skae Mistri" baksana "Sagalara Maidake Kari Nanga"-ko pe-skaa.
"Dokdori" golpoko Somerset William Maughamni dakmesokaniko segipa British mande onga.
Indiba uko uni kan-dikgipa golporangna mingsingbata.
Ua manderangni aro biaprangni gimin golpo sena namnikbata.
“"Skangsranggipa Aiao Inmanani Kam'-ko Jeffrey Archerni "The First Miracle"-oniko pe-skaa.
Jeffrey Archer British Parliamentni Member ong'achim; uaba dostangna pattoko donako man'ahachim.
Ua bang-bea songsarni golporangko sea baksana, kan-dikgipa golporangko sena changbeachim.
“Rongtalgipa Mande"-ko Frank Harrisni "The Holy Man"-oniko pe-skaa.
Sakini golporangoniko minggniko raa : "Walsimsim"-ko “Dusk"-oniko aro “Oe Dongenggipa Kelki" ko "The Open Window"-oniko pe-skaa.
"Saki"-ara Hector Hugh Munro-ni (1870-1916) kan-dikgipa golporangko seanio bimingtangko on'gija jakkalgipingipa biming onga.
Uni ma'a paa British manderang, indiba ua Burmaosa atchiachim.
Ua Russiao aro uni ja'mano Pariso songbad seani kamko ka-aha.
Uni gisiko nikjagringe chanchiatani bil wa'sabeachim, indiba ua janggi tanganio kakketkon aro chong'motkon sena namnikbataha.
"Oe ara bon'ataniko pe'sele dongipa ong'a.
Iano on'gipa golporango ramram English kattarangkosan jakkalaia; sentencerangba altua, badiabarangosan sentencerang bakroaia.
Indimangba pe-skaania altujachim.
Pe-skaanio asol gunkode jaktuatna manja, indiba porainasienggiparangni janggi [1i] --- Page 7 --- tangani bewal, gadang, bilsi aro uarang gitako gisiko done, on'tiprak jujaatanirangkode gelna man ja.
Englisho katta ramramsan aro katta tong ge'sasan dongaigipa ong'omangba, A-chikkuode katta Banobara orto apsansranggipa A-chikku kattako man'jae orto apsananggipako jakkalna ga-aka.
Pe-skaanio basakobade katta mingsaon ja'gue dongaia.
Sentencesaon “it, he, she" pronounrang dongon, Englishode sako miksonga ma'sina altua; indiba jakkalna nangani gimin, man-dika.
Ma-siatna gitade Proper Nounrangkon jakkalpiltaina nangaia.
Sentence ro'giparangkora, semi-colonko jakkale bakgni daka; man'jatelode fullstopko on'srange sentencesako sentencegni dake pe-rarona.
Indake dakanio sentenceni mangsonganiko aro ortoko gimaatjana simsakna ga'aka.
Kan-dikgipa golporang mingpraknin dingtangmancha ong'ani donga aro pe-skaanio uko jaktuatna man'ja.
Pe-skagipa kattani ba sentenceni ortoko ku'prete ku'gipino seskaanio sechongmotani bimang, bewal aro gunrangoni agre chel-angna nangja.
Golpo namako poraigakmanon, uko gipinrangna rengsi on'pana skani mandeo namen bilsua.
Skidapani donggipa golpo ong'ode, sanabade namgni ong'naba donga ingipa chanchianiba poraigipani gisikona nabaa.
Gipin a'songrangni kugipino segipa je seanikoba an·ching pe-skagiminonikosa poraina chol ong'paaia.
kandikgipa golpoko seani gunrang aro chol-budirangko uie-ma-sie ra'gen aro bang-bata golporangko poraidapangna skani nakatgen ine anga kadonga.
Ia ki-tapna Agandapani"-ko Ma Gracie K.
Marakko seatna nom-bokani salrango uarang angna gisik ritchengpilani ramako mesoka.
Ia Ki-tapna Agandapaniko sena angni mol-molon, ua jechakjaha.
Ma Gracie K.
Marak, Madam, Agandapaniko seanina anga nang:ko mittelbea.
Brucellish K.
Sangma [ii] --- Page 8 --- AGANDAPANI Dingtang ku-sikoniko A-chikkuona pe-skaaniara rakbegipa kam ong'a.
Sakgipinni segiminkosa pe-skaengani gimin, uko tiktak kattarangko on'e ma'siatna namen neng beani ong-a; maina kattako namnika kattarangko donatoara inangsongaoni sretnaba donga.
Brucellish K.
Sangma nambegipa, knatobegipa, kragipa kattarangko jakkale ia ki-tapo ming kolgrik golporangko pe'skaaha.
Ua kingsamangmang ki-taponiko ragija, bang-a dingtang dingtang ki-taprangoniko ra'e pe-skagiminko kadime ki-tap kingsana tariaha.
lano segimin golporang knana gitik dake ga-subca aro Mitam golporang skidapani mitamrang gisikko hariatani.
mitanrang ka-dingatani aro gisik nangatbeani ong'a.
Ia golporangko chatro chatrirang ba ja-delgiminrangmangba poraina namnikbegen ine ka'donga.
Dated Tura, Graciefields K.
Marak.
the 8th Sept.
Ringre Gittim, Tura.
